source: Job 1 hardware check on the Mac, node + @julusian/midi (CoreMIDI), scratch script outside the repo

keyTest.what: messages per input port while fader 1 moves bottom-top-bottom

dawMode.echo: the device echoes on/off in the form it was sent; no echo when already in that state
dawMode.offReply: before the off echo it reports surface mode: ch7 CC30 and CC31 = 6 (Custom Mode 1), twice

ledRgb.use: row 1: slot A's active knobs blue, slot B's orange, the rest dark (20 Nov)
ledRgb.source: Programmer's Reference v1.0, as used by github.com/DiegoDimuro/launchcontrol-3-xl-leds
ledRgb.verified: unverified: the 1-minute LED check on the Mac

use.37: hold (hand-held mode, #239): LED green held, amber held + holdSuspect, off not held
use.38: auto-hold on/off: LED green on, off off
use.39: slot A previous (slot.html; one half per slot, 20 Nov)

trackLeft.note: 103/102 seen in the order the user pressed left, right; direction not isolated

mode.effect: opens/closes the device's Mode Select page

report.alsoCc31: sent alongside CC30; equals CC30 in DAW sub-modes, CC30 - 5 for Custom Modes 9-16 (meaning not documented)

surfaceMode.set: host sends ch7 CC30 <value> on the DAW port; the device applies it and echoes the report
surfaceMode.query: host sends ch8 CC30 0 (B7 1E 00); reply is ch7 CC30 <value>
surfaceMode.modeSelectPage: while the Mode Select page is open, the 16 buttons send no button CCs: they pick Custom Modes (seen: upper button 1 = 6, lower row = 22-29 left to right; upper buttons 2-8 not pressed on this page) and the surface leaves DAW Mixer. DAW mode itself stays on. Only the Mode button closes the page; DAW off/on does not

palette.set: B0 <button cc> <index> (ch1 static), B1 = flash, B2 = pulse

amber.note: 9 and 96 look the same to the user; seen as orange

palette.clear: send index 0 on ch1, ch2 and ch3 to stop a flash or pulse

localLedsInDawMode.note: no button LED lit on press in DAW mode; the host owns every LED

fastTurn.note: accelerates up to +-4 per message; decode as value - 64

display.seen: CONDUCTOR on line 1, READY on line 2

exit.result: LEDs back to normal, display clear, fader 1 back on the MIDI port (128 msgs, 0 on DAW)
